class Applier
  check(usage: Use) -> CheckResult
  apply(usage: Use) -> ApplyResult
class ApplierClient(Applier)
  __init__(transport)
  check(usage: Use) -> CheckResult
  apply(usage: Use) -> ApplyResult
enum ApplyOutcome
  APPLIED = 'applied'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  EXPIRED = 'expired'
  REVOKED = 'revoked'
  LOST = 'lost'
  NOT_PERMITTED = 'not_permitted'
  TARGET_REFUSED = 'target_refused'
  CONSUMER_REFUSED = 'consumer_refused'
  UNSUPPORTED_KIND = 'unsupported_kind'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass ApplyResult
  outcome: ApplyOutcome | None
  revision: str
  headers: dict[str, str]
dataclass AuditEntry
  sequence: int
  time: str
  event: str
  name: str
  revision: str
  subject: Subject | None
  consumer: str
  target: str
  outcome: str
dataclass AuditPage
  outcome: PageOutcome | None
  entries: list[AuditEntry]
  next: str
  at_end: bool
const CONSUMERS
const CREDENTIAL_KINDS
dataclass CheckResult
  outcome: ApplyOutcome | None
  revision: str
dataclass CredentialResource
  name: str
class DispatchError(ValueError)
  __init__(code)
const EXECUTION_GUARANTEES
class Holder
  store(expected_revision: str, registration: Registration) -> StoreResult
  rotate(expected_revision: str, rotation: Rotation) -> RotateResult
  revoke(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> RevokeResult
  list(cursor: str, limit: int) -> MetadataPage
  audit(cursor: str, max_entries: int) -> AuditPage
class HolderClient(Holder)
  __init__(transport)
  store(expected_revision: str, registration: Registration) -> StoreResult
  rotate(expected_revision: str, rotation: Rotation) -> RotateResult
  revoke(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> RevokeResult
  list(cursor: str, limit: int) -> MetadataPage
  audit(cursor: str, max_entries: int) -> AuditPage
dataclass Limits
  max_credentials: int
  max_secret_bytes: int
  tombstone_retention_ms: int
  audit_retention_ms: int
  audit_capacity: int
  secure_store: SecureStore | str
  supported_kinds: list[str]
dataclass Metadata
  name: str
  kind: str
  revision: str
  state: State | str
  scope: Scope
  registered_by: Subject
  registered: str
  expires: str
  header: str
  last_applied: str
dataclass MetadataPage
  outcome: PageOutcome | None
  limits: Limits
  records: list[Metadata]
  next: str
  complete: bool
enum MetadataReadOutcome
  FOUND = 'found'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  CONFLICT = 'conflict'
dataclass MetadataReadResult
  outcome: MetadataReadOutcome | None
  current: Metadata | None
enum PageOutcome
  PAGE = 'page'
  GAP = 'gap'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
const RESOURCE_ACTIONS
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
dataclass Registration
  name: str
  kind: str
  scope: Scope
  expires: str
  header: str
  secret: bytes
enum RevokeOutcome
  REVOKED = 'revoked'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  CONFLICT = 'conflict'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'

  ROTATED = 'rotated'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  CONFLICT = 'conflict'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  NO_SECURE_STORE = 'no_secure_store'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'

  consumers: list[str]
class ScopedApplier
  check(usage: Use) -> CheckResult
  apply(usage: Use) -> ApplyResult
class ScopedApplierClient(ScopedApplier)
  __init__(transport)
  check(usage: Use) -> CheckResult
  apply(usage: Use) -> ApplyResult
class ScopedHolder
  store(expected_revision: str, registration: Registration) -> StoreResult
  rotate(expected_revision: str, rotation: Rotation) -> RotateResult
  revoke(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> RevokeResult
  metadata(name: str) -> MetadataReadResult
class ScopedHolderClient(ScopedHolder)
  __init__(transport)
  store(expected_revision: str, registration: Registration) -> StoreResult
  rotate(expected_revision: str, rotation: Rotation) -> RotateResult
  revoke(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> RevokeResult
  metadata(name: str) -> MetadataReadResult
enum SecretReadOutcome

  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  EXPIRED = 'expired'
  REVOKED = 'revoked'
  LOST = 'lost'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'

enum SecureStore

  SECRET_SERVICE = 'secret-service'
  FILE_0600 = 'file-0600'
  MACOS_KEYCHAIN = 'macos-keychain'
  NONE = 'none'
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)
enum ServiceErrorCode

  INVALID_RESULT = 'invalid_result'
  UNKNOWN_VERSION = 'unknown_version'
  UNKNOWN_SERVICE = 'unknown_service'
  UNKNOWN_METHOD = 'unknown_method'
  WRONG_MODE = 'wrong_mode'

  ACTIVE = 'active'
  EXPIRED = 'expired'
  REVOKED = 'revoked'
  LOST = 'lost'

  CONFLICT = 'conflict'
